fields.body_md:
## At a glance

The University of Waterloo is in Waterloo, Ontario. This page uses its **Master of Data Science and Artificial Intelligence (MDSAI) co-op** to show real costs and entry rules.

The most important fact is that Waterloo charges by the course. The latest international rate is **CAD 6,272** per course, which is **₹4.09 lakh**. The co-op programme has nine courses.

| | MDSAI co-op |
|---|---|
| Campus | Waterloo, on campus |
| Length | 16 months full time, with one co-op term |
| Intake | September only |
| Tuition for 9 courses (our sum) | **CAD 56,448** |
| Minimum average | **78%** overall |
| English test, if needed | TOEFL **5**, IELTS **7.5** |
| Application deadline | **15 January** for September |

Waterloo is a designated learning institution. IRCC's list shows it as a public institution. Its DLI number is O19305471522.

## What it really costs

The study permit asks you to show enough money for tuition, living costs and travel. Read the [proof of funds guide](/study-abroad/study-in/canada/canada-proof-of-funds-guide) for the rules.

Tuition for nine courses is **CAD 56,448** (**₹36.84 lakh**), by our sum of the latest rate. Incidental fees are **CAD 1,014.11** for each full-time term. The co-op fee is **CAD 836**. Waterloo has not posted a September 2027 rate.

IRCC also asks for **CAD 23,448** for living costs (**₹15.30 lakh**) and your flights. Waterloo does not split the 16 months by year, so ask it for your first-year tuition. Rents are in our [cost of living guide](/study-abroad/study-in/canada/canada-cost-of-living).

Rupee amounts use **₹65.27 per Canadian dollar**, the Bank of Canada rate for 27 November 2026. Rates move every day and your bank will charge its own rate, so treat the rupee figures as a guide.

## Getting in

Waterloo asks for an honours bachelor's degree in a related field with at least **78%**. The real cut-off is higher. It does not require the GRE. You need three references and a statement of up to 500 words. See the [programme page](/study-abroad/program-detail/canada/university-of-waterloo/waterloo-mdsai-co-op) for the details.

## Deadlines

The co-op programme admits only in the fall. The deadline for a September start is **15 January**. Waterloo reviews complete applications within about **8 to 10 weeks** of the deadline.

## Popular programs for Indian students

- [Master of Data Science and Artificial Intelligence (Co-op)](/study-abroad/program-detail/canada/university-of-waterloo/waterloo-mdsai-co-op): 16 months, CAD 6,272 per course, one paid co-op term.

## Who it suits

**A strong choice if** you have a strong computer science or statistics degree and want a co-op term inside a master's.

**Think carefully if** you need a January or May start, or a fixed fee. Waterloo charges by the course and may change the rate.

## Sources

- [MDSAI co-op programme page](https://uwaterloo.ca/future-graduate-students/programs/by-faculty/math/data-science-and-artificial-intelligence-co-op-master-data). Checked on 28 November 2026.
- [MDSAI tuition page](https://uwaterloo.ca/data-science/graduate-programs/master-data-science-and-artificial-intelligence/tuition). Checked on 28 November 2026.
- [Master's and PhD tuition, Winter 2027, international students](https://uwaterloo.ca/finance/masters-and-phd-program-tuition-winter-2027-international). Checked on 28 November 2026.
- [Data Science admission requirements](https://uwaterloo.ca/data-science/graduate-programs/admission-requirements). Checked on 28 November 2026.
- [Data Science application deadlines](https://uwaterloo.ca/data-science/graduate-programs/application-deadlines). Checked on 28 November 2026.
- [Vector Scholarship in Artificial Intelligence at Waterloo](https://uwaterloo.ca/data-science/vector-scholarship-artificial-intelligence). Checked on 28 November 2026.
- [IRCC designated learning institutions list](https://www.canada.ca/en/immigration-refugees-citizenship/services/study-canada/study-permit/prepare/designated-learning-institutions-list.html). Checked on 28 November 2026.
- [IRCC proof of financial support](https://www.canada.ca/en/immigration-refugees-citizenship/services/study-canada/study-permit/get-documents/financial-support.html). Checked on 28 November 2026.
- [Bank of Canada exchange rates](https://www.bankofcanada.ca/rates/exchange/daily-exchange-rates/). Checked on 28 November 2026.

Fees and rules change. Always confirm on the university's own website before you pay or apply.

faq_json.q: How much does the Waterloo MDSAI co-op cost for international students?
faq_json.a: Waterloo's latest schedule lists CAD 6,272 per course, or CAD 56,448 for nine courses by our sum. Incidental fees are CAD 1,014.11 per full-time term and the co-op fee is CAD 836.

faq_json.q: What marks do I need for the Waterloo MDSAI?
faq_json.a: An honours bachelor's degree in a related field with at least 78% overall. Waterloo says the real cut-off is much higher because admission is competitive.

faq_json.q: Is the GRE needed for the Waterloo MDSAI?
faq_json.a: No. Waterloo does not require GRE scores. It says scores can help your application.

faq_json.q: What is the deadline for the MDSAI co-op?
faq_json.a: 15 January for a September start. The co-op programme admits only in the fall. Confirm that 15 January 2027 applies to September 2027.
